clips.title: The story
paras: At Refuge Pointe, Captain Veronica Nials directs Stromgarde's defense as her kingdom crumbles. She faces Syndicate treachery and Boulderfist ogres in the Arathi Highlands.

After the Third War, Stromgarde shattered, and its people faced invading Boulderfist ogres and the Syndicate's treachery. At Refuge Pointe, Captain Veronica Nials commands the surviving Stromgarde defenders. She directs Alliance champions against Syndicate leaders, including Lord Falconcrest and the warlock Marez Cowl. She also seeks the badges of fallen soldiers so their grieving families can learn what became of them.

When Rhag Garmason and the dwarven defenders of Dun Modr asked Stromgarde for help, Captain Nials had to refuse. Dark Iron saboteurs had devastated the Thandol Span, but her troops could not spare a single blade beyond the Arathi Highlands. Honor and duty bound them to defend their homeland while Stromgarde remained occupied.
